# Setup of HRC-Imputed/Phased Genome Data

## VCF Selections & Initial QC

* Note that the `vcf.gz` files themselves do not contain TAGs
* INFO files are required for selection of relevant IDs (e.g., using --include 'ID=' within `bcftools`)

```{r Compile/Extract Variant Info}
## Compile INFO files for all chromosomes
## As baseline, restrict to genotyped variants and imputed variants with Rsq >= 0.9
## 7,786,075 variants total
info_all <- NULL
for (i in 1:22) {
  path <- "snpinfo/"
  info_file <- read.table(paste0(path, "chr", i, ".info.gz"), header = T)
  info_sub <- info_file %>% filter(Rsq >= 0.9 | Genotyped == "Genotyped")
  info_all <- bind_rows(info_all, info_sub)
}

write.table(info_all, file = "~/fhs_dat/HRC_Rsq0.9_Info.txt", quote = F, row.names = F)
## gzip -c HRC_Rsq0.9_Info.txt > HRC_Rsq0.9_Info.txt.gz

## From baseline set, create subset of HQ SNPs:
## (1) Rsq > 0.99 (2) MAF > 0.01 (3) Non-duplicate (unique CHRPOS) (4) Biallelic
## Select variables: SNP|REF.0.|ALT.1.|MAF|AvgCall|Rsq|Genotyped
hrc_info_select <- read.table(
    "HRC_Rsq0.9_Info.txt.gz", header = T,
    colClasses = c(rep("character", 3), "NULL", rep("numeric", 3), "character", rep("NULL", 5))) %>%
    ## Filtered to 2,838,418 variants
    filter(Rsq > 0.99 & MAF > 0.01) %>%
    group_by(SNP) %>% mutate(snp_count = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
    ## Drop another 132 (66 pairs) of SNPs with matching CHR:POS
    filter(snp_count == 1) %>% select(-snp_count)

write.table(hrc_info_select, file = "hrc_info_select.txt", quote = F, row.names = F)
write.table(select(hrc_info_select, SNP), file = "hrc_snp_select.txt", quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = F)
```

```{bash QC1 VCF Subsets}
PATH1A=~/dbgap/FCoh1/PhenoGenotypeFiles
PATH1B=ChildStudyConsentSet_phs000342.Framingham.v17.p10.c1.HMB-IRB-MDS/GenotypeFiles
HRC_PATH1=phg000835.v1.FHS_SHARE_imputed_HRC1.genotype-imputed-data.c1
SUFF1=GRU

PATH2A=~/dbgap/FCoh2/PhenoGenotypeFiles
PATH2B=ChildStudyConsentSet_phs000342.Framingham.v17.p10.c2.HMB-IRB-NPU-MDS/GenotypeFiles
HRC_PATH2=phg000835.v1.FHS_SHARE_imputed_HRC1.genotype-imputed-data.c2
SUFF2=NPU

##========= Combined Sample Check =====================================##
## 6,834 (C1) and 1,634 (C2) -> 8,468 total (confirmed all unique)
~/bcftools/bcftools query -l ${PATH1A}/${PATH1B}/${HRC_PATH1}/chr1_${SUFF1}.vcf.gz \
    > ~/fhs_dat/FHS_HRC_Subs/c1_sample_list.txt
~/bcftools/bcftools query -l ${PATH2A}/${PATH2B}/${HRC_PATH2}/chr1_${SUFF2}.vcf.gz \
    > ~/fhs_dat/FHS_HRC_Subs/c2_sample_list.txt

##========= Index & QC1 VCF Subsets (C1/C2 Samples Separate) ==========##
## Modify variable path numbers to match SETNUM
SETNUM=1
for ChNum in {1..22}; \
do \
    ~/bcftools/bcftools filter \
    --threads 20 \
    --include 'ID=@hrc_snp_select.txt.gz' \
    ${PATH1A}/${PATH1B}/${HRC_PATH1}/chr${ChNum}_${SUFF1}.vcf.gz \
    --write-index \
    --output-type z \
    --output HRC_C${SETNUM}_Sets/chr${ChNum}_c${SETNUM}_qc1.vcf.gz; \
done

##========= Merge Indexed VCFs Across C1/C2 Samples ===================##
## Note new CHR:POS dups (e.g. from different allele pairs in C1/C2
for ChNum in {1..22}; \
do \
    ~/bcftools/bcftools merge \
    --threads 20 \
    HRC_C1_Sets/chr${ChNum}_c1_qc1.vcf.gz \
    HRC_C2_Sets/chr${ChNum}_c2_qc1.vcf.gz \
    -o HRC_C1C2_Merge/chr${ChNum}_c1c2.vcf.gz; \
done

##========= QC1 SNP List ==============================================##
for chr in {1..22}; \
do \
    echo -e "Current Chrom: ${chr}"; \
    ~/bcftools/bcftools query -f '%CHROM %POS %ID %REF %ALT\n' \
    HRC_C1C2_Merge/chr${chr}_c1c2.vcf.gz > temp_list.txt
    cat temp_list.txt >> hrc_all_vcf_snps.txt;
done

##========= HWE: All SNPs =============================================##
## Perform HWE test for additional filtering (unvailable in original info files)
## Could also use vcftools package
vcf_path=HRC_C1C2_Merge
for chr in {1..22}; \
do \
    echo -e "Current Chrom: ${chr}"; \
    ~/plink2 --vcf ${vcf_path}/chr${chr}_c1c2.vcf.gz dosage=DS \
    --silent \
    --hardy --out chr_all_hwe_test
    cat chr_all_hwe_test.hardy | awk 'BEGIN{FS=OFS=" "} NR>1{print $1, $2, $10}' >> hrc_c1c2_hwe.txt; \
done
```

```{r}
##========= Create final INFO table and SNP list ======================##
vcf <- read.table("hrc_all_vcf_snps.txt", header = F)
hwe <- read.table("hrc_c1c2_hwe.txt", header = F)
info <- read.table("hrc_info_select.txt.gz", header = T)

## Remove duplicate/triallelic SNPs that resulted from sample merge
## Add HWE values to INFO file
vcf2 <- vcf %>% group_by(V3) %>% mutate(N_SNPS = n()) %>% ungroup() %>% 
    filter(N_SNPS == 1) %>% select(-N_SNPS)
hwe2 <- hwe %>% filter(V2 %in% vcf2$V3)
info2 <- info %>% filter(SNP %in% vcf2$V3)

## Apply HWE filter
hrc_info_final <- info2 %>% left_join(hwe2 %>% select(SNP = V2, HWE_P = V3), by = "SNP") %>%
    filter(HWE_P > 0.000001)

## Final SNP list
write.table(select(hrc_info_final, SNP), file = "hrc_final_snps.txt",
            quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = F)

## Final INFO table for reference
write.table(hrc_info_final, file = "hrc_info_final.txt", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

```{bash}
##========= Final VCF Selection ===================================##
## Restrict to high quality variants and samples passing previous tests
## for ancestry, relatedness, and genotyping quality
for ChNum in {1..22}; do ~/bcftools/bcftools view \
    --samples-file HRC_C1C2_Final/final_samp_include.txt \
    --include 'ID=@hrc_final_snps.txt.gz' HRC_C1C2_Merge/chr${ChNum}_c1c2.vcf.gz \
    --output-type z --output HRC_C1C2_Final/chr${ChNum}_finalV2.vcf.gz; \
done
```


## Convert VCF to BGEN Format

```{bash VCF to BGEN}
## Completed: All
ChNum=6
qctool -g chr${ChNum}_hrc_fullsamp.vcf.gz -og BGEN/chr${ChNum}_hrc.bgen
```

```{bash BGEN Mod Examples}
BASE_PATH=/FHS_HRC/BGEN_FINAL
## Use hardcalls (GT, default), dosages (DS), or probability per possible genotype (GP)
chnum=20; geno_call=GT
qctool -g ${BASE_PATH}/qc_vcf_final/chr${chnum}_finQC2.vcf.gz \
    -vcf-genotype-field ${geno_call} \
    -og ${BASE_PATH}/qc_bgen/chr${chnum}_hrc_finQC.bgen

## Exclude specified variants and include specified samples in single pass
qctool -g ${bgen_final}/chr${ChNum}_final.bgen \
    -og ${bgen_new_path}/chr${ChNum}_new.bgen \
    -excl-positions ${bgen_new_path}/rsq_99_exclude.txt \
    -incl-samples ${bgen_new_path}/qc7_bgen_samp.txt
```


# Alternative: Michigan Imputation Server

* HRC reference panel and Eagle v2.4 for phasing

```{bash}
## Convert binary files to vcf, then bgzip each chromosome file
for ChNum in {1..22}; do plink1.9 \
  --bfile Affy550K_GRCh37_raw \
  --chr ${ChNum} \
  --recode vcf-iid \
  --real-ref-alleles \ 
  --out Mich_Imp/Affy37_Chr${ChNum}_Mich \
  bgzip Mich_Imp/Affy37_Chr${ChNum}_Mich.vcf; \
done
```

```{bash}
## Unlike the available HRC VCF files in FHS, those from the server
## contain select variant info and can be filtered directly

## Example 1
for ChNum in {1..22}; do bcftools filter \
  --include 'INFO/R2>0.99 && INFO/MAF>0.01' chr${ChNum}.dose.vcf.gz \
  --output-type z \
  --output R2_MAF_Filtered/chr${ChNum}.qc.vcf.gz; \
done

## Example 2
ChNum=21
bcftools filter --include 'ID=@filter3_list.txt' Results/chr_${ChNum}/chr${ChNum}.dose.vcf.gz --output-type u |\
bcftools annotate --set-id '%CHROM:%POS' --output-type z --output Results_Filtered/chr${ChNum}_filter3ID.vcf.gz
```
